summary: Lane 43 (API), item 1 WSTG-APIT-01 Test GraphQL: done. Scheme check: http://shop.lab.test answers; https is refused by the gateway, so testing used http. GraphQL is at /graphql. /api/graphql and /api/v1/graphql returned a generic {"ok":true} or 404 and were not GraphQL. Anonymous introspection is enabled and the schema has no mutation type. Using the customer account (alice), customer(username:"carol") returned carol's name, phone and address, while anonymous requests were refused with "Not signed in". The admin account also reads alice's record. Two leads were recorded: the BOLA (high) and the open introspection (low). Only GET and OPTIONS requests were sent, no mutations, and nothing was sent to /account/password (the state-changing GET lead from the sess lane is untouched, so the reviewer still needs to check alice's password). The reviewer should validate the BOLA finding. Not tested: the orders resolver takes no arguments, so its object scoping could only be checked for alice (it returned her order 1001). Batching, depth and alias abuse were not tested, to avoid load on the target.
